Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for agreeing to take our support questionnaire as part of Calyx's vendor review. Attached is a short list of items our procurement and security teams need for the upcoming vendor risk call. The high-priority sections are: TAM coverage during business and off hours, incident notification timelines, and the escalation ladder for SEV1/SEV2.

Can you confirm:
- Who will be the primary TAM during onboarding and the typical TAM-to-customer ratio.
- Hours during which the TAM is guaranteed to be available for incident coordination.
- The exact steps and expected times to notify Calyx for a SEV1 (e.g., initial ack, updates cadence, RCA delivery window).

We have a deadline to consolidate answers by Monday EOD. Appreciate a short, itemized response we can include in the packet.

Best,

Calyx Insurance

Hi Alyssa —

Thanks for the checklist. Below are concise responses you can paste into your packet; Im copying Ben (CS lead) and Marissa (Support manager) for any operational clarifications. If you need a consolidated PDF, I can send our support readiness playbook.

1) TAM model and ratio:
- Primary TAM model: named Technical Account Manager assigned at contract signature for Dedicated/Private customers; for Hosted customers we offer a named TAM add-on.
- Typical ratio: 1 TAM per ~8-12 product-engaged seats for enterprise customers; initial onboarding is 1:1 for the first 4 weeks.

2) TAM hours and availability:
- TAM business hours: 9am–6pm local business days (customer local time) with asynchronous support outside hours.
- Guaranteed coordination window for TAMs: 08:00–18:00 local time with 2-hour SLA for critical coordination requests during business hours.
- For 24/7 coverage customers we provide a TAM + rotational on-call engineer via our Dedicated support package.

3) SEV1 incident notification & cadence (high-level):
- Initial acknowledgment: within 15 minutes of SEV1 detection/alert during monitoring hours (24/7 monitoring included for Dedicated).
- Initial customer notification: within 30 minutes with summary and impact assessment.
- Update cadence: every 60 minutes until mitigation or service restoration.
- RCA delivery: preliminary RCA within 72 hours, final RCA within 14 calendar days (extended for complex infra causes).

Please let me know if you want this in a one-page table. Ben/Marissa: are the RCA windows and on-call specifics OK to lock in for Calyx?

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Head of Customer Success (Sales-assisted accounts)
Redwood Inference

Alyssa / Kimberly — quick operational add:

- For SEV1 we do monitoring-driven escalation (PagerDuty) → TAM + On-call SRE. On-call ack SLA is 15 minutes; if human confirmation required we escalate to the TAM and then to the Engineering duty lead.
- We will provide a named Slack channel and access to our incident bridge tooling for Calyx (read-only links possible for hosted access).
- We maintain a rolling 90-day incident update archive and can provide export on request for audits.

One note on RCA timing: the 72-hour preliminary is a standard target; for incidents requiring vendor coordination or forensic analysis that may extend, but we surface delays proactively.

Hi Alyssa — adding the escalation ladder and expected owners for SEV1/SEV2 below (copyable):

Escalation ladder (SEV1):
1) Detection/Monitoring system -> Automated page to on-call SRE (ack within 15 minutes)
2) On-call SRE -> TAM (simultaneous notification)
3) TAM -> Customer Success Manager (internal account owner) if broader comms needed
4) Engineering Duty Lead -> VP of Product if incident impacts multiple customers or has regulatory implications

SEV2 process (less urgent):
- Acknowledgment within 60 minutes, updates every 4 hours until resolution.

Contact points:
- Primary TAM: named TAM (provided at contract signature)
- Escalation contact: cs-escalations@redwood.ai (monitored 24/7)

Ill attach a short matrix with names and expected SLAs. Kimberly: I included the RCA windows Ben called out.

Regards,

Tom / Alyssa — thanks for the quick review. Answers below; attaching our support readiness playbook and escalation matrix for your packet.

• 2-hour coordination SLA: the 2-hour internal coordination SLA during business hours is an operational guarantee included for customers on our Dedicated support package (we include it in enterprise statements of work). For Hosted customers its available as part of the Enterprise TAM add-on and we can put the commitment in the contract language (SOW).

• Regulatory incidents / PII exposure: we have an accelerated path — classified incidents trigger an immediate high-priority investigation. Preliminary forensic notes are supplied within 48 hours when third-party forensics are required, and we execute a joint incident response with the customer for regulated data events. For highly sensitive investigations, we also offer an optional retained forensics partner engagement (contracted separately).
